rows.Origin:
Bred by Weeks Roses (United States, 1988).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 1989 as 'Celebrity'.
rows.Bloom: Deep yellow. Fruity fragrance. 30 to 35 petals. Large bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
